E2-2025-T3-P1-S3.trunk: Nagpur's plan calls for hospitals to set aside wards and advises builders to give laborers a break（那格浦尔计划要求医院预留病房，并建议建筑商让工人休息）
structure: 主句并列谓语一：Nagpur's plan calls for hospitals to set aside cold wards
└ 目的状语(for)：for treating heatstroke patients
并列谓语二：and advises builders to give construction laborers a break from work
└ 时间状语：on very hot days
E2-2025-T3-P1-S3.logic: plan作共同主语，通过calls for和advises并列提出医疗与劳动保护两类措施；两个不定式分别说明医院和建筑商应采取的行动。
notes: call for sb to do 意为“要求某人做某事”。
set aside 在此意为“留出、预留”。
heatstroke 指中暑，尤指严重热射病。

E2-2025-T3-P1-S11.trunk: The effects were amplified by humidity and the lack of shade（高温影响因湿度和缺少遮阴而加剧）
structure: 主句：the effects of the heat were amplified by humidity and the lack of shade
├ 同位插入说明〔修饰 humidity〕：an often neglected factor in heat alert systems
└ 介词短语〔修饰 lack of shade〕：at the late-morning outdoor ceremony
E2-2025-T3-P1-S11.logic: 被动主干指出两项放大高温影响的因素；破折号之间的同位语专门解释湿度为何容易被现行预警忽略。
notes: amplify 在此意为“加剧、放大影响”。
neglected factor 指常被忽视的因素。
late-morning 指上午较晚、接近中午的时段。

E2-2025-T3-P1-S18.trunk: HAPs shouldn't just include responses but also recommend measures（行动计划不应只含应急响应，还应提出中长期措施）
structure: 主句：HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses but also recommend medium- to long-term measures
├ 并列结构：not just include A but also recommend B
└ 定语从句(that)：that could make communities cooler
E2-2025-T3-P1-S18.logic: not just...but also...把计划从应急处置扩展到长期降温；that从句进一步界定中长期措施的目标。
notes: medium- to long-term 是共享term的省略写法。
emergency responses 指突发高温时的应急响应。
make communities cooler 包括绿化、建筑改造等结构性措施。
